sloka: रुदन्नाह प्रियम् पुत्रं सत्यपाशेन संयतः ।कैकेय्या चोद्यमान्स्तु मिथो राजा तमब्रवीत् ॥२-३४-३०॥
transliteration: rudannāha priyam putraṁ satyapāśena saṁyataḥ ।kaikeyyā codyamānstu mitho rājā tamabravīt ॥2-34-30॥

translations.english: The king who was bound by the cord of truth and instigated by Kaikeyi said, wailing in distress:
